note: Exact replacements for deliberate drawing changes merged after I1's single-sheet oracle. Each case keeps every format exact; the stream that changed it is named in streams. Applied after known_single_sheet_main_pins.json.

rebaseline.note: known_single_sheet.json was re-recorded whole for this change; the main pins and these streams' replacements were folded into it.

f2-surface-texture.note: F2 (#18): an AP242 part-wide surface texture (ISO 10303-1110) is the default finish: its ISO 1302 symbol and 'Ra 3.2' are drawn beside the title block, and the pmi_not_extracted problems for the read textures go (hw_every_kind's face texture is refused instead: its face is neither planar nor cylindrical). Plan diff: one requirement added, the not-projected problems replaced, sheet fill/basis; SVG diff: the symbol's three strokes, its glyphs and its text run only. macOS PNG hashes recorded; Linux PNG (and hw_every_kind's Linux pdf/svg, whose stale platform override is removed) to be recorded by CI's record_single_sheet job.

f4-page-fit-projection.note: #13: a pinned sheet and scale are judged as the automatic search judges its candidates. 102 cases lose page_fit_uncertain because their finished drawing's items and views all fit the sheet (pinned placements on the canonical sheet, GRM-03 at A3/A4 10:1, mounting_plate at A3 2:1 and A4 1:1, ...); 51 keep it and gain a fix (the nearest size and/or scale that fits) and its message clause. Only the plan changes: before/after plans differ in that one problem (and, where withdrawn, the basis clause 'the views may not fit' becoming 'the finished drawing fits'); SVG, PDF and PNG are byte-identical. Linux plan overrides for 62 of these cases need re-recording with record_single_sheet.

g3-draw-assembly-part.note: The D4 warning assembly_drawn_whole: an assembly drawn whole (no part chosen) gains one plan problem naming its parts. Only the plan changes; SVG, PDF and PNG are byte-identical. Plan hashes re-recorded on the f3-problem-language merge (its problem wording applies to these plans too).

j3-shaft-fits.note: J3 (#30): an AP242 shaft fit stated as a class alone (LIMITS_AND_FITS('g','shaft','6') etc.) is printed on the turned diameter that states its size, with its ISO 286 limits, as a hole fit is on its bore's callout: hw_spool_fits_intent's 2× ø130 gains 'g6 (-0.014/-0.039)' and its ø70 OD 'f7 (-0.030/-0.060)', hw_thumbwheel_thread_knurl_intent's ø10 'f7 (-0.013/-0.028)', and their 'stated without limits' pmi_not_lowered problems go. Plan diff: those labels, bases and claims, and the placements the longer labels move (the front view's dimension band grows 2 mm on the spool; the spool's ø70 leader now runs along its silhouette, and three new leader-crosses-hole findings); SVG/PDF follow. macOS PNG hashes recorded; their stale Linux plan/svg/pdf overrides are removed, and Linux PNG (and any Linux byte override) is to be recorded by CI's record_single_sheet job.
